entities.name: Silas A. Holcomb
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Silas Alexander Holcomb was a Nebraska lawyer and politician elected as the ninth Governor of Nebraska and serving from 1895 to 1899. He ran under a fusion ticket between the Populist and the Democratic Party.
